```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  comment = NA,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 5
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(tibble)
})

safe_read_csv <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  out <- tryCatch(
    read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  out
}

kable_simple <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(invisible(NULL))
  knitr::kable(df, digits = digits, caption = caption)
}

find_fig <- function(fname) {
  p <- file.path("figures", fname)
  if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  if (file.exists(fname)) return(fname)
  NA_character_
}

show_fig <- function(fname) {
  p <- find_fig(fname)
  if (is.na(p)) return(invisible(NULL))
  knitr::include_graphics(p)
}
```

# 1. Executive Summary

```{r}
file_overview <- safe_read_csv("../file_overview.csv")
cleaned <- safe_read_csv("../cleaned_dataset.csv")
audit <- safe_read_csv("../audit_duplicates.csv")
site_counts <- safe_read_csv("site_counts.csv")
site_dx <- safe_read_csv("site_by_diagnosis.csv")

kable_simple(file_overview, "Input tables overview")
```

*Commento breve: questa tabella riassume i file sorgente, dimensioni e missingness globale per tabella.*

```{r}
if (!is.null(cleaned)) {
  n_sub <- nrow(cleaned)
  n_site <- if ("site_id" %in% colnames(cleaned)) n_distinct(cleaned$site_id) else NA_integer_
  n_asd <- if ("diagnosis_label" %in% colnames(cleaned)) sum(cleaned$diagnosis_label == "ASD", na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
  n_ctrl <- if ("diagnosis_label" %in% colnames(cleaned)) sum(cleaned$diagnosis_label == "CTRL", na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
  dup_pairs <- if (!is.null(audit) && "n_scans" %in% colnames(audit)) sum(audit$n_scans > 1, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_

  quick <- tibble(
    metric = c(
      "Subjects in cleaned dataset",
      "Number of sites",
      "ASD count",
      "CTRL count",
      "Subject-modality pairs with duplicated scans"
    ),
    value = c(n_sub, n_site, n_asd, n_ctrl, dup_pairs)
  )
  kable_simple(quick, "Quick summary")
}
```

*Commento breve: qui vedi subito se il dataset e' realmente multi-site e se il bilanciamento classi e' adatto a DG.*

---

# 2. Site / Domain Coverage

```{r}
kable_simple(site_counts, "Subjects per site")
```

*Commento breve: il numero di siti determina la fattibilita' di LOSO/LODO per generalizzazione cross-site.*

```{r}
kable_simple(site_dx, "Diagnosis distribution by site")
```

*Commento breve: questa tabella mostra eventuali sbilanciamenti di classe all'interno dei siti.*

```{r, out.width='100%'}
show_fig("01_subjects_per_site.png")
```

*Commento breve: barplot dei campioni per sito, utile per valutare se i domini sono sufficientemente popolati.*

```{r, out.width='100%'}
show_fig("02_diagnosis_by_site.png")
```

*Commento breve: vista stacked per capire la composizione ASD/CTRL in ogni dominio sito.*

---

# 3. Missingness and Completeness

```{r}
missingness <- safe_read_csv("missingness_by_column.csv")
if (!is.null(missingness)) {
  kable_simple(head(missingness, 25), "Top 25 columns by missingness")
}
```

*Commento breve: le colonne con missingness elevata sono candidate all'esclusione dal feature set.*

```{r, out.width='100%'}
show_fig("03_top_missing_columns.png")
```

*Commento breve: grafico ranking delle variabili con maggiore incompleta copertura.*

```{r, out.width='100%'}
show_fig("04_missingness_heatmap.png")
```

*Commento breve: heatmap di missingness (soggetti vs colonne critiche) per identificare pattern non casuali.*

---

# 4. Duplicates and QAP Deduplication

```{r}
audit_summary <- safe_read_csv("audit_duplicates_summary.csv")
kable_simple(audit_summary, "Duplicate scan summary by modality")
```

*Commento breve: questa tabella quantifica il numero medio/massimo di scan per soggetto prima della dedup.*

```{r}
if (!is.null(audit)) {
  preview <- audit %>%
    select(subject_id, modality, n_scans, mode, selected_unique_id, selected_quality_score, selection_reason) %>%
    head(20)
  kable_simple(preview, "Dedup audit preview (first 20)")
}
```

*Commento breve: preview operativo dell'audit con la scelta scan finale e relativo score.*

```{r, out.width='100%'}
show_fig("09_duplicates_scans_distribution.png")
```

*Commento breve: distribuzione del numero di scan per soggetto/modalita', utile per stimare rischio leakage pre-dedup.*

---

# 5. Feature Set and Filtering

```{r}
feature_selection <- safe_read_csv("feature_selection.csv")
kable_simple(feature_selection, "Feature selection (coverage + rules)")
```

*Commento breve: dettaglia quali feature sono state mantenute/escluse e il motivo (coverage/mandatory).*

```{r}
if (!is.null(feature_selection)) {
  fs <- feature_selection %>%
    group_by(feature_group, kept) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  kable_simple(fs, "Kept vs dropped by feature group")
}
```

*Commento breve: sintesi utile per verificare se il feature set finale e' abbastanza ricco per modellazione.*

---

# 6. Site Shift (Transportability)

```{r}
shift_tbl <- safe_read_csv("qap_shift_by_site.csv")
if (!is.null(shift_tbl) && nrow(shift_tbl) > 0) {
  kable_simple(shift_tbl, "QAP descriptive shift by site")
} else {
  note_tbl <- tibble(
    note = "Shift table is empty (typically because only one site is available in current export)."
  )
  kable_simple(note_tbl, "Shift analysis status")
}
```

*Commento breve: se la tabella e' vuota, la valutazione cross-site non e' stimabile con questo export.*

---

# 7. DG Splits (LOSO/LODO)

```{r}
split_summary <- safe_read_csv("split_summary.csv")
if (!is.null(split_summary) && nrow(split_summary) > 0) {
  kable_simple(split_summary, "Generated LOSO/LODO splits")
} else {
  note_tbl <- tibble(
    note = "No LOSO/LODO files generated: insufficient number of eligible domains (single-site case)."
  )
  kable_simple(note_tbl, "Split generation status")
}
```

*Commento breve: in modalita' multi-site, qui troverai i fold train/val/test per ogni dominio lasciato fuori.*

---

# 8. Final Assessment

```{r}
final_tbl <- tibble(
  Dimension = c(
    "Data quality pipeline",
    "Deduplication auditability",
    "Model-ready dataset",
    "Cross-site transportability testability"
  ),
  Status = c(
    "Implemented",
    "Implemented",
    "Implemented",
    if (!is.null(site_counts) && nrow(site_counts) > 1) "Ready" else "Blocked by single-site export"
  ),
  Note = c(
    "Quality + missingness + diagnostics generated",
    "Audit file includes selection reason and quality score",
    "One row per subject, leakage-safe merge",
    "Requires full ABIDE II multi-site phenotypic input"
  )
)
kable_simple(final_tbl, "Overall pipeline status")
```

*Commento breve: con export multi-site completo questa stessa pipeline passa da analisi descrittiva a DG sperimentale piena.*
